zh: 与桌面版双向对齐：模型思考内容不再混进回答（识别各家思考字段和 think 标签，只出思考被截断时自动放宽上限重试）；模型方案可选认证方式（bearer / x-api-key / api-key 等），测试连接失败时给出地址、状态、上游原文和排查建议，密钥不回显；数据导入、报表、月报等平台页面可由超级管理员收回「全员开放」，收回后页面和背后接口一并拦截；开场打招呼不再当对话标题；技能中心可直接上传技能包；修复「Anthropic API Key」认证选项未生效。
en: Two-way alignment with the desktop edition: model reasoning no longer leaks into answers (all common reasoning fields and think tags are recognised, with one retry at a higher limit when only reasoning was produced); model profiles can choose the auth header (bearer / x-api-key / api-key, etc.), and failed connection tests show the endpoint, status, upstream body and a hint with keys redacted; super admins can withdraw platform pages such as data import, reports and monthly reports from everyone, blocking both the page and its APIs; greeting-only first messages no longer become chat titles; skills can be uploaded from the Skill Hub; fixed the Anthropic API Key auth option not taking effect.
